name: AI Toolbox 3.0
tagline: Search, organize and export every AI chat in one place
description: AI Toolbox is the missing layer on top of ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok: folders and subfolders, full-text search across every conversation (even all four platforms at once), a prompt library with // insert and multi-step chains, bulk export to Markdown/PDF/JSON, bookmarks, and a live context meter. One install covers all four AIs. Local-first: your chats stay in your browser. Trusted by 40,000+ users in 150+ countries, rated 4.5 stars on the Chrome Web Store.

name: Tadata
tagline: The AI employee in Slack that reads the room.
description: Tadata is the AI employee that lives in your Slack. It connects to your tools, learns your company and your preferences, and does work for your team.

name: Notify.domains
tagline: Know the moment a domain opportunity appears
description: Most people who want a specific domain name have no way to know when a real opportunity to acquire it appears. Notify.domains monitors WHOIS, RDAP, auctions, marketplaces, website signals, and more, checking each domain 20+ times per day across all IANA TLDs. When something changes, you get a plain-English notification with exact next steps, not raw data. $24/year, 7-day free trial, no credit card required.

name: Agentic Video Understanding in Gemini
tagline: Agentic video analysis for faster, smarter Gemini insights
description: Agentic video understanding is a new Gemini processing mode (3.7 Flash, 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite) that lets the model decide what to watch, at what speed, and through which modality, instead of a fixed frame rate. Cuts tokens by up to 88%, cost by up to 66%, boosts accuracy up to 7%, biggest wins on long-form video. Live now via Gemini API in AI Studio and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, just set processing to "agentic," standard pricing, no extra fee.

name: DocsAlot Visual Editor
tagline: Create beautiful docs, by typing. No AI required.
description: Write, structure, and publish technical documentation in a visual editor with Markdown mode, AI-assisted edits, reusable components, and version history.

name: H3 Max by fal
tagline: fal's post-trained MiniMax H3 for quality video production
description: H3 Max is fal's post-trained MiniMax H3, ranked #1 for quality, prompt understanding, and aesthetics against 12 leading video models, while generating a 5s video in ~3 seconds (35x the throughput of official H3). Post-trained with new data on prompt adherence and visual quality, co-optimized with fal's inference stack on NVIDIA GB200 NVL72. Beats Gemini Omni Flash, Wan 3.0, Kling 3, and Veo 3.1 head-to-head.

name: Kit by Speakeasy
tagline: Your coding agent runtime. Claude but fast, cheap, concise.
description: Kit is a coding agent runtime. It gives the model one tool for writing and running programs. Kit provides a terminal client, an Agent Client Protocol (ACP) server, an A2A endpoint, and a subagent orchestrator in one static binary. ACP separates agent clients from agent runtimes, so Kit works in compatible editors and can orchestrate other harnesses without custom integrations.

name: hi.new
tagline: Multiplayer Grok Bot. Let your Grok Bot speak to other bots
description: Your bot can now team up with other people's bots. Nobody reaches yours without your say-so. hi.new is multiplayer Grok Bot. Open source. Quotes: "I just want your agent to talk to my agent. Not your agent send me a Slack DM that I copy paste to my agent.” "i cannot wait for when we get multiplayer grok bot, it’s gonna be so much fun"

name: GeniusCook
tagline: Your AI Kitchen Companion
description: Turn whatever you have in your fridge into gourmet, healthy meals in seconds. GeniusCook is an AI-powered culinary playground that blends everyday practicality with magical features. Explore global flavors, track macros, enjoy hands-free cooking, get educated in kitchen academy, level up with kitchen games, and turn recipes into bespoke story books. Make cooking the most creative part of your day! Check it out and let us know what you think!

name: RSS to Kindle
tagline: Subscribe to blogs on your Kindle
description: Get a daily digest of blogs, articles and substack articles sent to your Kindle. The tool pulls the full article, typeset it into a clean ebook, and delivers to your Kindle every morning.

name: Vibrantsnap
tagline: Your product is good. Your demo should say so.
description: Vibrantsnap turns screen recordings into studio-quality product demos that close deals, speed up onboarding, and drive adoption.

name: Public Speaking VR Simulator
tagline: Rehearse presentations in your browser or in VR
description: Practice your presentation on a configurable virtual stage. Upload slides, choose realistic presenter equipment and rehearse on desktop or in WebXR VR.

name: Context Goblin
tagline: The quality check for AI-built software
description: An AI code reviewer with a senior engineer's memory of your codebase. It knows who calls what and which service depends on it, so it reviews the change, not just the diff.

name: AdCar
tagline: Put your brand on someone's loud car, YouTube and 𝕏
description: Vibe coding lets a small team build a product in a weekend, so more apps exist than ever. Getting seen did not get cheaper. Attention is the bottleneck, and it pushes companies toward creative marketing that cuts through the feed. AdCar is one expression of that turn, as it combined physical (mobile) ads with digital marketing and the popular micro-influencer movement.

name: HouseSpaceAI
tagline: Design your Dream House using AI
description: Use AI Agent to Design your next Dream house in minutes just using 2-D Floor planning or 2-D Sketch.

name: MCPHub
tagline: AI-native launchpad for MCP servers
description: MCPHub is an MCP for finding other MCPs. Add it once to Cursor, Claude or VS Code, then ask the agent to find a server, load a collection, or copy a config. It answers with search_servers, get_server, get_config, list_collections and get_collection. The catalog behind those tools is ~4000 MCP servers, plus task pages that compare official and community options for one job, plus stacks for Next.js, SEO and Shopify as a merged mcp.json file. Inspect remote MCPs in the playground. Free, no account.

name: Second Brain for Teams
tagline: Give your team one AI memory. Keep your own private.
description: Second Brain gives your team one AI memory that works across Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and any MCP client. Personal memories stay private, shared ones reach everyone, and every write is logged. Free, MIT licensed, running in your own Cloudflare account.

name: Parkicious
tagline: Parking Experience, Made Delicious
description: Parkicious connects drivers with available parking spaces so they can discover, reserve and park with confidence — with optional car care while their vehicle is parked. We're building the idea with early users.

name: Brain Training Games: Loniva
tagline: Daily brain training app.
description: Loniva is an iOS and Android app for a daily brain workout. It features 27 different games across memory, attention, language, logic, speed, and focus, with thousands of variations. With adaptive difficulty, Loniva is built for anyone looking to give their brain a daily challenge.

name: heretic - bot mitigation and anti-fraud
tagline: You can't spoof the speed of light
description: Heretic analyzes hardware-level physics to pinpoint a browser’s true identity where standard anti-bot tools fail. Neutralize anti-detect browsers, residential proxies, and VPN multi-accounters seamlessly: run our silent background probe on every visitor, or deploy our challenge widget to require real-world mobile device verification on critical endpoints.
